messages.subject: Having trouble integrating R code to work in shiny while mining tweets for sentiment analysis
parts:
I am new to shiny and i would really appreciate if someone helped me. Basically i am trying to do sentiment analysis of tweets. I found one blog explaining how to do it in R and i worked fine  in R but i am trying to integrate that with shiny and i am stuck. if only  could i convert reactive type to data frame then i could plot my graph but i couldn't find anywhere how to convert type closure into list .World cloud works fine but i am not being able to plot graph of my positive and negative sentiment . Please help :)

Errors are :" evaluation nested too deeply: infinite recursion / options(expressions=)? "while i make variable in within methods a function
and " no applicable method for 'within' applied to an object of class "reactive" " while i don''t make them a function

Here's my code
server.R


shinyServer(
 
  function(input, output){
   
    myword <- reactive({
      as.character(input$word)
    })
    
    startdate <- reactive({
      as.character.Date(input$startdate)
     
    })
    enddate <- reactive({
      as.character.Date(input$enddate)
     
    })  
   
    mycount <- reactive({
      as.numeric(input$tweetcount)
    })
    mydisplaycount <- reactive({
      as.numeric(input$displaytweet)
    })
    tweets <- reactive({tweets <- tweetmine(myword(),    ##  i din;t include tweetmine function but it works correctly
                                            mycount(),startdate(),enddate())
    })

 

   finaldata_emo <-reactive( (tweets))
   finaldata_class_emo <- reactive(finaldata_class_emo <- classify_emotion (finaldata_emo, algorithm="bayes", prior=1.0) )
 
   emotion <-  reactive(emotion <- finaldata_class_emo[,7] )

  emotion <-  is.String(emotion)
   emotion[is.na(emotion)] = "unknown"
  
    finaldata_class_pol <-  reactive(finaldata_class_pol <- classify_polarity(finaldata_emo,algorithm ="bayes")) 
   polarity <-  reactive(polarity <- finaldata_class_pol[,4])
 
   sentiment_dataframe <- reactive(sentiment_dataframe <- data.frame(text= is.data.frame(finaldata_emo()), emotion= emotion() , polarity= polarity(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE ))
  sentiment_dataframe <- reactive(sentiment_dataframe <- within(sentiment_dataframe(), emotion <- factor(emotion(),levels=names(sort(table(emotion(),decreasing = TRUE))))))
 
  output$ggplot <-renderPlot( {ggplot(sentiment_dataframe(), aes(x=emotion)) + geom_bar(aes(y=..count.., fill=emotion())) +
                                  scale_fill_brewer(palette="Dark2") +
                                  theme(legend.position='right')+
                                 ylab('Number of Tweets') +
                                  xlab('Emotion Categories')
     } )
   
    
     output$wordcloud <- renderPlot({
      wordcloud(tweets(),
                scale=c(7,0.5),
                max.words=400,
                random.order=FALSE,
                rot.per=0.35,
                use.r.layout=FALSE,
                colors=brewer.pal(8,
                                  "Dark2"))
    })
    
     output$sentiment <- renderDataTable({
      
         head(sentiment_dataframe(),mydisplaycount())
     }
     )
 
     output$data <- renderPrint({
      head(tweets(), mydisplaycount())
    })
  }
)
